description: Usage profiles (E3, PK6): the criterion weights of the weighted sum model; the weights of a profile sum to 1. Annual cost (PK7) = mean costCriterion per task × dailyVolume × daysPerYear, the same volume for both profiles (an assumption; cost is linear in the volume). Fixed before the main run.

A.name: quality first
A.example: e.g. extracting data from contracts, where an error is costly

B.name: cost first
B.example: e.g. high-volume background processing, classifying documents
